lines.en: I walk slowly, though no bell rings.

lines.zh: 花斑像一张摊开的地图。
lines.en: My patches look like an unfolded map.
My hooves press and the grass lies down.
My stride is far steadier than a pig's.
I walk the fence line, grazing as I go.

lines.zh: 花斑牛在平原上很常见。
lines.en: Pinto cows are common on the plains.

lines.zh: 我转身费劲，所以先看清路。
lines.en: Turning is hard, so I look before I move.

lines.zh: 尾巴赶着蝇子，我从不停。
lines.en: My tail swats flies without pause.

lines.zh: 这身黑白，是在地球染上的。
lines.en: These black and white patches came from Earth.

lines.zh: 每一步都沉，草地被我踩实。
lines.en: Each step is heavy; the grass packs under me.
I avoid mud; hooves sink.

lines.zh: 我低头走过低枝，省力气。
lines.en: I duck under branches to save effort.

lines.zh: 我站着反刍，嘴一直在动。
lines.en: I stand chewing the cud, mouth always working.
Two flies land on my patches.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，世界就慢下来。
lines.en: I blink slowly and the world slows.
The clouds drift slow, and so does my gaze.

lines.zh: 我朝左边走两步，又停住。
lines.en: I take two steps left and stop again.
The wind lays the grass to one side.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴，甩到自己的侧腹。
lines.en: My tail flicks and hits my own flank.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里呼出一口白气。
lines.en: A puff of white breath leaves my nose.

lines.zh: 这一片草，够我站到傍晚。
lines.en: This patch of grass could last me till evening.
A companion calls from far off.
I keep shifting which legs carry me.
I hear hooves. Unfamiliar ones.
My ears have not stopped moving.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在篱笆的横木上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the fence rail.
The grass is short here; not quite enough.

lines.zh: 我嚼完这一口，再想别的。
lines.en: When this mouthful is done, I will think.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，草屑飞了。
lines.en: I sneeze and grass bits fly.
The sun warms my patches.

lines.zh: 你站得比我高，但我不怕。
lines.en: You stand taller, but I am not afraid.
What is that? Grass?

lines.zh: 我抬头，只用一只眼看你。
lines.en: I look up with one eye only.
You do not smell of cattle.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把花斑给你看。
lines.en: I turn my flank to show you my patches.

lines.zh: 别站在我正前方，我转身慢。
lines.en: Do not stand right in front; I turn slowly.
I step forward, then stop.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的白斑上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my white patch.
A tuft of grass stands between us.
I bring my nose over and sniff.
I watch you without moving.
Only when you step back do I keep grazing.
I low once and step back.
That left my ribs aching.
I shake my head to drive it off.
Ten health goes quickly.
Blood on my patches.

lines.zh: 我前腿一屈，差点跪下去。
lines.en: My forelegs buckle and I nearly kneel.
I pant heavily, my belly rising.
This wound keeps me from walking fast.
I lean toward the herd.
The pain makes my head sway.
I know the wheat in your hand.
I walk over slowly, unhurried.
Set it down and I will lower my head.

lines.zh: 我伸着脖子，等你手落低些。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and wait for your hand to drop.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发紧，我往前挪了一步。
lines.en: My throat tightens and I shuffle one step closer.

lines.zh: 我等着，等你手再往下一点。
lines.en: I wait for your hand to come a little lower.
Open the sack a little wider.

lines.zh: 我伸舌头卷了一下，没够着。
lines.en: I stretch my tongue out and come up short.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴到你手背上。
lines.en: I press my nose to the back of your hand.
When this handful is gone, is there more?
You hit my ribs solidly.
I shift, and you step back too.
Do not crowd; I take up space.
I turn aside a little.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我哼了一声。
lines.en: That knock made me grunt.
We have trodden the grass to mud.
Dirt on my patches now.
You stepped on the edge of my hoof.
I stay; you go around.
Push again and I shove back.

lines.zh: 我朝那头叫了一声，很长。
lines.en: I call to her, one long low note.
Her patches are more even than mine.
We stand side by side, chewing.
I nudge her gently with my head.
This season the herd is noisy.
I walk slowly around her.

lines.zh: 别的牛都在看，我不在乎。
lines.en: The others stare; I do not care.
My tail flicked her in the face.
She walks off; I follow.
We head down toward the river.
I take a mouthful of grass.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，这果子不新鲜。
lines.en: One sniff tells me this fruit has turned.

lines.zh: 我的舌头一卷，草叶就进了嘴。
lines.en: One curl of my tongue and the leaves are in.

lines.zh: 这东西沉，我用头顶着滚。
lines.en: It's heavy, so I roll it along with my head.
This is not food.

lines.zh: 我用头顶把它滚到一边。
lines.en: I roll it aside with my head.
I lick the wheat grains one by one.
It stuck to my nose.
I look up to see who threw it.

lines.zh: 我绕着它闻了一圈才下嘴。
lines.en: I circle it once, sniffing, before I try.

lines.zh: 草叶一动，我停住了咀嚼。
lines.en: A blade stirs and I stop chewing.
I have turned my head.
It is not large. Neither am I.
I lower my horns, short as they are.

lines.zh: 我横过身子，把小牛围在里头。
lines.en: I turn broadside and tuck the calf behind me.
I let out a low call.
It has entered my meadow.

lines.zh: 我把前蹄抬起，悬着没落下。
lines.en: I lift a forehoof and hold it there.
I do not chase; I only stand.
If it charges, I run.
I keep watching it and stop eating.
It circles; I turn my head.
I herd the calf toward the herd.

lines.zh: 它退了一点，我还不放松。
lines.en: It backs off; I stay tense.
My tail goes stiff and the tip quivers.
This place is too open to hide.

lines.zh: 我四条腿钉在原地，不先动。
lines.en: All four legs planted, I refuse to move first.

lines.zh: 它每靠近一步，我就呼气。
lines.en: Each step closer, I exhale harder.
The herd is behind me.
One step more and I use my head.
I shove once, and it rings.
The blow makes even the grass shake.
My horns are not sharp, but hard.
I rear and bring a hoof down.

lines.zh: 你退开三步，我站在原地喘。
lines.en: You back off three steps; I stand there panting.

lines.zh: 撞完我也站不稳，蹄下打滑。
lines.en: After the hit I stagger, hooves slipping.
I bite the corner of your coat.
I am no hunter; I guard the herd.
You cry out; I am spent too.

lines.zh: 再动手，我就用整个身体撞。
lines.en: Again, and I hit you with all my weight.

lines.zh: 我在平原上撑起四条腿。
lines.en: I push up on four legs on the plains.
My patches are wet and dark.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是草和天。
lines.en: The first thing I see is grass and sky.
It takes a while to stand steady.
The cow licks me beside.

lines.zh: 我想找东西吃，先找了草。
lines.en: I want to eat; I look for grass first.
The wind here is softer than Earth's.

lines.zh: 我试着叫，声音卡在喉咙里。
lines.en: I try to call and the sound catches in my throat.
My voice is coarser than expected.
I walk a few steps with the herd.

lines.zh: 我的花斑在阳光下摊开。
lines.en: My patches spread in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾巴，跑了一小段。
lines.en: I lift my tail and run a short way.
Fire tightens my hide.

lines.zh: 我重重落地，蹄子都软了。
lines.en: I land hard and my hooves give way.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我抬头乱蹬。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I rear and kick.
The blast tips me onto my side.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
Something runs cold in my blood.
Empty belly; even standing is hard.
Lightning falls and I lock up.
The ground is gone; I fall.
